calorieTracking.title: Calorie tracking is here
calorieTracking.description: See how many calories a recipe or menu has, set a daily goal on your new Dietary tab, and log what you eat straight from any recipe or menu page. Recipes and menus that would put you over your goal are highlighted, and you can filter your cookbook by calorie range too.

smarterSearch.title: Smarter search and shareable filters
smarterSearch.description: Recipe and menu filters now live in the page URL, so you can share or bookmark a filtered view and it'll look exactly the same when you open it. Search is live as you type everywhere in the app, recipes can be found by name or by specific ingredients, and every active filter shows as a chip you can remove with one click.

newIngredientCatalog.title: A bigger pantry, smarter recipes
newIngredientCatalog.description: The ingredient catalog has been rebuilt with over 700 items, including meat and fish, all in metric units and browsable by category. Recipes now have a "From my pantry" filter that shows only what you can make right now, plus a heads-up popup if anything in your pantry has expired. This rebuild reset existing ingredients, recipes, menus, and pantry contents - your account itself is unaffected.

profileControls.title: Make your profile yours
profileControls.description: Edit your name and pick from a set of cooking-themed avatars right on your profile. And if you ever need to, you can now permanently delete your account from Settings.

underTheHood.title: Behind-the-scenes maintenance
underTheHood.description: This update focused on keeping the app's technical foundations current - no new features this time, just upkeep to keep things running smoothly.

reliability.title: Built to recover
reliability.description: A friendly screen now appears if something goes wrong, and we'll let you know if your connection drops - both recover automatically once things are back to normal.

mobilePolish.title: Smoother on mobile
mobilePolish.description: Fixed input fields zooming the page, long titles overflowing the screen, and cramped buttons on phones; Purchase History and the bottom navigation are steadier too.

accountSecurity.title: Password reset & email verification
accountSecurity.description: Reset a forgotten password by email, verify your email address, and change your password anytime from Settings.

flexibleSignIn.title: Sign in your way
flexibleSignIn.description: Log in with your username or email, and skip straight to your dashboard right after signing up.

redesign.title: A brand-new look
redesign.description: Every page has been redesigned, with dark and light themes, plus dozens of fixes and polish along the way.

pantryAware.title: Pantry-aware recipes
pantryAware.description: Recipe pages now show which ingredients you already have and scale quantities per portion.

statsCharts.title: Richer statistics
statsCharts.description: New charts for menus per category and average cooking time by recipe type.

lockout.title: Safer sign-in
lockout.description: Repeated failed sign-ins now lock the form briefly, with a live countdown, and signing out asks for confirmation first.

instantUpdates.title: Instant updates
instantUpdates.description: Lists refresh automatically after you add, edit or delete - no page reloads.

launch.title: Cooking Assistant goes live
launch.description: The app is now publicly available for anyone to use.

fasterLoads.title: Faster page loads
fasterLoads.description: Pages, charts and reports now load on demand, so the app starts up noticeably faster.

privateMenus.title: Your menus are now private
privateMenus.description: Only you can open or change your own menus, and your session lives in a more secure cookie.
